faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about working with an insurance advisor.

items.question: How much does a consultation cost?
items.answer: The initial consultation is completely free with no obligation to purchase any product. My goal is to educate and help you find the right coverage for your needs.

items.question: How do I know which insurance I need?
items.answer: That's exactly what our consultation is for. I take the time to understand your life situation, goals, and finances before making any recommendations.

items.question: How long does it take to get coverage?
items.answer: It depends on the product and insurer. Some policies can be in place within days; others that require medical underwriting may take a few weeks.

items.question: Am I too young for life insurance?
items.answer: No — in fact, the younger and healthier you are, the lower your premiums will be. Starting early locks in lower rates and provides peace of mind for your family.

items.question: What's the difference between term and whole life insurance?
items.answer: Term insurance covers you for a set period (e.g., 20 years) and is generally more affordable. Whole life provides permanent coverage and builds cash value over time.

items.question: Do I still need insurance if I have a group plan through work?
items.answer: Group benefits are a great foundation, but they typically don't follow you when you change jobs. Individual coverage ensures you're always protected regardless of your employment.

items.question: Can I get insurance as a newcomer to Canada?
items.answer: Yes. Many insurance products are available to newcomers, even those without a long Canadian credit or medical history. I specialize in helping newcomers navigate this process.

items.question: Is your service available in Persian?
items.answer: Yes — I'm fluent in both English and Persian (Farsi) and provide fully bilingual service to make sure nothing is lost in translation.

life-insurance.title: Life Insurance
life-insurance.subtitle: Protect the people you love most. Life insurance ensures your family is financially secure no matter what happens.
life-insurance.intro: Life insurance is the foundation of any solid financial plan. It provides your loved ones with a tax-free lump sum payment in the event of your death — giving them the financial stability to maintain their lifestyle, pay off debts, and build their future.
benefits: Tax-free death benefit for your beneficiaries
Pays off mortgage and outstanding debts
Replaces lost income for your family
Peace of mind for the people you love

types.name: Term Life Insurance
types.description: Affordable coverage for a set period (10, 20, or 30 years). Ideal for young families and those with specific financial obligations.

types.name: Whole Life Insurance
types.description: Permanent coverage with a cash value component that grows over time. Builds wealth while protecting your family.

types.name: Universal Life Insurance
types.description: Flexible permanent insurance combining a death benefit with tax-advantaged investments.

disability-insurance.title: Disability Insurance
disability-insurance.subtitle: Your income is your most valuable asset. Disability insurance protects it when illness or injury keeps you from working.
disability-insurance.intro: Statistics show that 1 in 3 Canadians will experience a disability lasting more than 90 days before the age of 65. Disability insurance replaces a portion of your income — typically 60–85% — so you can focus on recovery without financial stress.

types.name: Short-Term Disability
types.description: Covers you for weeks to months following an illness or injury. Provides immediate income replacement.

types.name: Long-Term Disability
types.description: Provides ongoing income replacement for extended periods — often until age 65 — for serious conditions.

types.name: Own-Occupation Coverage
types.description: The gold standard. Pays out if you're unable to perform the specific duties of your own occupation.

critical-illness-insurance.title: Critical Illness Insurance
critical-illness-insurance.subtitle: A life-changing diagnosis shouldn't mean financial devastation. Critical illness insurance gives you the freedom to focus on recovery.
critical-illness-insurance.intro: Critical illness insurance pays a one-time, tax-free lump sum if you are diagnosed with a covered serious illness such as cancer, heart attack, or stroke. You can use this money however you need — medical expenses, time off work, modifications to your home, or simply reducing financial stress.
benefits: Use the money however you choose
Complements existing health and disability coverage

types.name: Standard Coverage
types.description: Covers major conditions including cancer, heart attack, stroke, and more. Most popular option.

types.name: Enhanced Coverage
types.description: Broader coverage for 25+ conditions including less common but serious illnesses.

types.name: Return of Premium
types.description: If you never make a claim, a portion of your premiums may be returned to you.

whole-life-insurance.title: Whole Life Insurance
whole-life-insurance.subtitle: Permanent protection with the added benefit of growing cash value — a cornerstone of long-term financial planning.
whole-life-insurance.intro: Whole life insurance provides coverage for your entire lifetime, along with a savings component called cash value that grows at a guaranteed rate. It's a disciplined, tax-advantaged way to build wealth while ensuring your family is always protected.
benefits: Borrow against your policy if needed

types.name: Participating Whole Life
types.description: Shares in the insurer's profits through dividends, which can further grow your cash value.

types.name: Non-Participating Whole Life
types.description: Fixed premiums and guaranteed cash value growth. Simpler and more predictable.

types.name: Limited Pay Whole Life
types.description: Pay premiums for a set period (e.g., 20 years) while maintaining lifetime coverage.

universal-life-insurance.title: Universal Life Insurance
universal-life-insurance.subtitle: The flexibility of term insurance combined with the wealth-building power of permanent coverage.
universal-life-insurance.intro: Universal life insurance is a flexible form of permanent insurance that separates the protection and savings components. You can adjust your premiums and death benefit as your life changes, while the investment component grows in a tax-advantaged account.

types.name: Indexed Universal Life
types.description: Links your cash value growth to a market index, offering growth potential with downside protection.

types.name: Guaranteed Universal Life
types.description: Focuses on guaranteed lifetime protection with minimal cash value — lower cost permanent insurance.

types.name: Variable Universal Life
types.description: Invest the cash value in a variety of sub-accounts for potentially higher returns (with more risk).

travel-insurance.title: Travel Insurance
travel-insurance.subtitle: Explore the world with confidence. Travel insurance protects you from unexpected costs wherever you go.
travel-insurance.intro: Canadian provincial health insurance provides very limited coverage outside Canada. A single medical emergency abroad can cost tens of thousands of dollars. Travel insurance ensures you're covered for emergencies, cancellations, and more — so you can focus on enjoying your trip.

types.name: Emergency Medical Insurance
types.description: Covers hospital, doctor, and emergency costs while travelling outside your province or Canada.

types.name: All-Inclusive Travel Insurance
types.description: Comprehensive plan covering medical, trip cancellation, baggage, and more.

types.name: Multi-Trip Annual Plan
types.description: Ideal for frequent travellers. One policy covers all trips taken within a year.
